test_title: RRB NTPC CBT-I Official Paper (Held On: 19 Jan 2021 Shift 1)
subject: general
question: A can complete a task in 40 days. If A and B can complete it together in 30 days, then in how many days can B alone complete the task?
solution:
**Given:**

Time taken by A to complete a work = 40 days

Time taken by A and B to complete the work together = 30 days

**Formula used:**

Work = Efficiency × Time

**Calculation:**

LCM of 40 and 30 is 120

Efficiency of A = (120/40) = 3 unit/days

Efficiency of A and B = (120/30) = 4 unit/days

Now,

Time taken by B alone to complete the work = [120/(4 – 3)]

⇒ 120/1

⇒ 120 days

**∴ The required time taken by B is 120 days**
